description: Predict MTEB task performance for public embedding models with explicit parameter-scale labels.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are all, articles, default, dentistry and oral health, dermatology, dev, and 32 more.
